headline: The ban on robot vacuums won’t make them safer, only worse
summary: Robot vacuums collect vast personal data, including maps, routines, cameras, and microphones. AI advancements increase privacy and security risks from these autonomous devices. A ban could worsen the problem by limiting choices and hindering future safety innovations.

headline: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream is a quirky life sim that’s worth buying at this discount
summary: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream for Switch is currently on sale for $52.99. It's a quirky life simulation game focused on building an island paradise with Mii characters. Players manage relationships between custom Miis, similar to a more eccentric Animal Crossing.

headline: Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth
summary: AI image generators can now create fake, reality-distorting images using Google Earth data. Users can generate scenes like 'refugees near the Mexican border' or a 'bomb crater near a hospital.' Google has acknowledged the issue after these AI-altered images were publicized.

headline: The major labels propose rules to keep AI slop off the charts
summary: Major record labels propose new rules to exclude AI-generated music from official charts. This initiative goes further than previous labeling proposals by industry bodies. The goal is to maintain chart integrity and prevent 'AI slop' from gaining legitimacy.

headline: X-Men Movie Casts Samara Weaving as the MCU's Emma Frost
summary: Samara Weaving has reportedly been cast in the MCU X-Men movie. She will be playing the role of Emma Frost. Weaving is known for her work in 'Ready or Not.'

headline: Everything Coming to HBO Max in August
summary: This article outlines new content arriving on HBO Max in August. Upcoming releases include 'Dragons and Lanterns.' Viewers can expect a fresh lineup of shows and movies.

headline: AMD Reportedly Plans To Raise GPU Prices, Too
summary: AMD is reportedly planning to increase its GPU prices. An industry insider suggests a price hike of about 10%. This follows a trend of rising component costs.

headline: Cyberpunk TCG: Exclusive Reveal of Jackie Welles and Judy Alvarez Cards
summary: Exclusive reveal of new Cyberpunk TCG cards is now available. Featured characters include Jackie Welles and Judy Alvarez. Details on their unique Legend and Unit abilities are provided.

headline: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
summary: Spain's PM blames traffickers for 60,000 migrants arriving in Ceuta from Morocco. Most migrants have since returned to Morocco by Friday evening. Italy suspended its Schengen agreement on free movement with Spain in response to the crisis.

headline: Watch: Moroccan police clash with migrants near border with Spain's Ceuta
summary: Moroccan police clashed with migrants near the Spanish territory of Ceuta. Thousands of migrants had reached Ceuta from Morocco. Over 25,000 migrants have voluntarily returned to Morocco.

headline: 'If that means I lose my job, so be it': Top Fifa official questions Infantino's World Cup plan
summary: A senior Fifa official strongly criticized President Gianni Infantino's World Cup plan. Infantino proposes selling stakes in Fifa competitions to private investors. The official expressed willingness to lose their job over their opposition to the plan.

headline: Disgraced funeral boss who failed to bury bodies jailed for 20 years
summary: Funeral director Robert Bush has been sentenced to 20 years in jail. He was convicted for failing to bury and cremate bodies. Bush also provided bereaved relatives with the ashes of strangers.
